dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. What's this cable used for?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈwʌts ðɪs ˈkeɪbəl ˈjuːzd ˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's used for connecting your laptop to a TV.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈjuːzd fər kəˈnɛktɪŋ jʊr ˈlæptɑːp tu ə ˌtiːˈviː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a camera. It's used for recording videos.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈkæmərə. ɪts ˈjuːzd fər rɪˈkɔːrdɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I need something for editing photos.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈniːd ˈsʌmθɪŋ fər ˈɛdɪtɪŋ ˈfoʊtoʊz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This software is used for editing photos and videos.
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈsɔːftwɛr ɪz ˈjuːzd fər ˈɛdɪtɪŋ ˈfoʊtoʊz ənd ˈvɪdioʊz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. And do I need a special plug?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ənd duː aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈspɛʃəl ˈplʌɡ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, this plug is fine in Thailand. It's used for charging the laptop.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɪs ˈplʌɡ ɪz ˈfaɪn ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. ɪts ˈjuːzd fər ˈtʃɑːrdʒɪŋ ðə ˈlæptɑːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. You can work on the sofa!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. juː kən ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ðə ˈsoʊfə!
